The [[Standard year/Legends|year]] '''104 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]]''' was a date in [[Timeline of galactic history/Legends|galactic history]].

==Events==
*[[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] told the [[Keeper of the Whills]] about the [[Skywalker family/Legends|Skywalker family's]] history through the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="TMOSWROTS">''[[The Making of Star Wars Revenge of the Sith]]''</ref>
*The ''[[Byblos Journal of Historical Science]]'' published ''[[Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji]]'', an article on the long history of the [[House Praji/Legends|Praji family]].<ref name="TTSP">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/source/praji/20090205.html|text=Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji|int=Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji}}</ref>
